decisions.reason: It fits the firm's utility and sewer-related customer base and uses its existing metal fabrication and finishing capabilities, so it is likely to remain in the range while demand is tested further.

Public waste bins are comparatively far from the firm's core fluid-handling and industrial fabrication focus, making them the most likely product to be discontinued if sales or margins are not convincing.
Ground sleeves are a straightforward extension of the firm's established metal component business and can be produced with existing skills, equipment, and sales channels.
Cast iron ground sleeves are related to the firm's infrastructure-oriented offer, but they are somewhat less natural than its steel-based products, so retention is likely but less certain.
Steel ground sleeves are closely aligned with the firm's steel-processing expertise and standard fabricated-product model, so they are likely to stay on the market.
